background: A schedule may only raise a prompt. It never contacts a service on its own; check, download and install each wait for a fresh, direct user approval naming the service, endpoint, operation and data.

admission.signature: AIUEIMG1: Ed25519 only (below the post-quantum floor). AIUEIMG2: 2 of 3 pinned signers, each with Ed25519 and ML-DSA-65 (native/update.kotoba, ADR-0286 stages 5a-5c; the TEST keys in test mode; production mode pins a VERIFICATION-ONLY signer set kept on one Mac, Amendment 7: no custody separation, not for deployment)
admission.digest: SHA-256 equals the manifest digest before any write
admission.rollback: UPDATE.BIN keeps the previous BOOTX64.EFI chain; a version must be strictly above the hash-checked floor in OSMETA.BIN (result 9; unreadable journal 10, fail closed; ADR-0286 amendment 4)

appUpdates: An installed app updates only to a catalog entry whose CID digest and signature verify; the old version stays until the new one is admitted.
